title: Build(deps): bump actions/setup-java from 6.0.0 to 6.0.1
body:
Bumps [actions/setup-java](https://github.com/actions/setup-java) from 6.0.0 to 6.0.1.
Release notes

Sourced from actions/setup-java's releases.

v6.0.1

What's Changed

  • Fix failing GitHub Actions job for temurin 17 by @​brunoborges with @​Copilot in actions/setup-java#1259
  • Fix Temurin EA E2E signature verification by @​brunoborges with @​Copilot in actions/setup-java#1260
  • Fix Alpine GPG verification failures and support multiple keys by @​brunoborges in actions/setup-java#1262
  • Fix import-safe checks when scripts are run from a path with symlinks by @​otaconix in actions/setup-java#1265
  • Avoid macOS GPG socket overflow on long runner paths by @​brunoborges with @​Copilot in actions/setup-java#1266
  • Complete v6 release highlights in README by @​brunoborges in actions/setup-java#1254
  • Group and slow routine Dependabot updates by @​brunoborges in actions/setup-java#1255
  • chore(deps-dev): update eslint and globals by @​dependabot[bot] in actions/setup-java#1256

New Contributors

  • @​otaconix made their first contribution in actions/setup-java#1265

Full Changelog: https://github.com/actions/setup-java/compare/v6.0.0...v6.0.1
